issue_context.title: Dev Server: History Mode does not work if the requested url looks like a .html file
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

 - #11282 (and a bunch of other tickets)
 is/are solved in `v5.0.0-beta2` if the filename does not end in `.html`. If `.html` is part of the route param, it still fails.
I expect vite to handle `.html` just like all the other file extensions, just like a webserver configured with a fallback option would: 
Serve file if it exists, otherwise serve `index.html`.

In e.g. nginx this behavior would be configured with something along these lines:
```        
       location / {
            try_files $uri /index.html;
        }
```

For the time being I've managed to achieve this by registering a custom plugin:
```typescript
{
      name: 'fallback-to-index-html',
      configureServer(server: ViteDevServer) {
        return () => {
          const handler = history({
            disableDotRule: true,
            rewrites: [
              {
                from: /$/,
                to({ parsedUrl, request }) {
                  const root = projectRootDir
                  const decodedPath = decodeURIComponent(parsedUrl.pathname)
                  if (decodedPath !== '/' && existsSync(join(root, decodedPath))) {
                    return decodedPath
                  }
                  const rewritten = decodedPath + 'index.html'
                  if (existsSync(join(root, rewritten))) {
                    return rewritten
                  }
                  return `/index.html`
                }
              }
            ]
          })

          server.middlewares.use(handler)
        }
      }
    }
``` 

For some reason the `to()` function seems to be only called if the URL has a `.html` suffix.
Otherwise the files are just served if they exist.
This makes me think there must be some special case handling, so `.html` files are excluded from the regular existence check.
That's why I think this workaround probably duplicates that logic which must be somewhere else in vite already and so it shouldn't just be applied to https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/aae3a83b5fb49bbd9f174cfeac66f00483829da4/packages/vite/src/node/server/middlewares/htmlFallback.ts#L18 .


It might be a good idea to fix this before v5.0.0 final as it might be another breaking change and so be on hold until v6.

### Reproduction

https://github.com/dschmidt/vite-history-mode

### Steps to reproduce

Run
```
pnpm vite
```

and try to open the following urls:
http://localhost:5173/oidc-callback.html serves actual html file ✅ 
http://localhost:5173/test.txt serves actual txt file ✅ 
http://localhost:5173/open/foo serves `index.html` and shows `foo` as route param from vue-router   ✅ 
http://localhost:5173/open/foo.gif serves `index.html` and shows `foo.gif` as route param from vue-router   ✅ (this is what was fixed for v5) 
http://localhost:5173/open/foo.html responds with 404 ❌ 

I expect vite to also serve `index.html` for the last url, so the rendered page can show `foo.html` as route param from vue-router
